[Intro]
[ch]D[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]

[Verse 1]
[tab]       [ch]D[/ch]                [ch]C[/ch]
He was just a blue-eyed Boston boy[/tab]
[tab]                       [ch]G[/ch]        
His voice was low with pain.[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]D[/ch]               [ch]C[/ch]   
"I'll do your bidding comrade mine,[/tab]
[tab]               [ch]G[/ch]
If I ride back again.[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]D[/ch]                    [ch]G[/ch]
But if you ride back and I am left[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]D[/ch]
You'll do as much for me.[/tab]
[tab]                      [ch]C[/ch]
Mother you know, must hear the news[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]D[/ch]            [ch]C[/ch]     [ch]G[/ch]
So write to her tenderly."[/tab]

[Instrumental]
[ch]D[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]

[Verse 2]
[tab]       [ch]D[/ch]                      [ch]C[/ch]
"She's waiting at home like a patient saint[/tab]
[tab]              [ch]G[/ch]         
Her fond face pale with woe.[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]D[/ch]                    [ch]C[/ch]
Her heart will be broken when I am gone[/tab]
[tab]                     [ch]G[/ch]       
I'll see her soon, I know"[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]D[/ch]              [ch]G[/ch]
Just then the order came to charge[/tab]
[tab]       [ch]D[/ch]                    
For an instant hand touched hand[/tab]
[tab]                     [ch]C[/ch]
They said "Aye" and away they rode[/tab]
[tab]                       [ch]G[/ch]     
That brave and devoted band.[/tab]

[Instrumental]
[ch]D[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]D[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]

[Verse 3] 
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                             [ch]C[/ch]          
Straight was the track to the top of the hill[/tab]
[tab]                         [ch]G[/ch]        
The rebels they shot and shelled.[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                   [ch]C[/ch]  
Plowed furrows of death through the toilling ranks[/tab]
[tab]                         [ch]G[/ch]       
And guarded them as they fell[/tab]
[tab]      [ch]D[/ch]                    [ch]G[/ch]
There soon came a horrible dying yell[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]D[/ch]                           
From heights that they could not gain[/tab]
[tab]                        [ch]C[/ch]
And those that doom and death had spared[/tab]
[tab]                  [ch]G[/ch]      
Rode slowly back again.[/tab]

[Instrumental]
[ch]D[/ch] [ch]C[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]

[Verse 4]
[tab]    [ch]D[/ch]                        [ch]C[/ch]
But among the dead that were left on the hill[/tab]
[tab]                           [ch]G[/ch]     
Was the boy with the curly hair[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]D[/ch]                  [ch]C[/ch]
The tall dark man that rode by his side[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]
Lay dead beside him there[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]D[/ch]                      [ch]G[/ch]
There's no one to write to the blue-eyed girl[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]D[/ch]
The words that her lover had said[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                 [ch]C[/ch]
Momma, you know, awaits the news[/tab]
[tab]                          [ch]G[/ch]
And she'll only know he's dead.[/tab]
